title: Clear Print Queue - Guide 1
content: Stop the print spooler, clear stuck print jobs, restart the print spooler, and try printing again.

title: Printer is online but jobs stay in queue
content:
Problem: Printer is online but jobs stay in queue on Ubuntu. Please help because I need this for work.
Root cause: 
Resolution: Cleared the print queue and reinstalled the approved printer driver.
